prose: Welcome to Inner Whirled, the new podcast with Dylan Saccoccio and Chance Garton, where we'll be providing deeply researched and well prepared podcasts on Spirit Whirled subjects, the language, symbolism, artifacts and system of the ancient universal priestcraft.

Episode 2 explores the ancient fingerprints of the Holy Sailors, called by the Greeks, the Pelasgians. Who were these sea-faring adventurers, who spread their systems of language, alphabets, priesthood, and architecture, around the known world? What does Pelasgi mean? Join us to track down the oldest origins available to us that show the remnants of the real universal empire.
